user_scope: Three portrait candidate illustrations for Main Menu, recurring Precision Workshop state, and Customer World Result; editable flow map only.

visual_requirements.primary_use: A calm workshop threshold makes the player's first choice—start or continue a craft—feel like entering a living place, while native controls keep the action readable.
visual_requirements.state_family_requirement: One normal state; native menu text/buttons and readability veil remain outside the image.
composition_constraints: No UI, text, logo, watermark, character portrait, or gameplay statistics inside the raster.
Preserve a quiet upper and central field for native Korean menu controls.
The art is a background illustration, not a fake completed screen.

visual_requirements.primary_use: At every ten-level Precision choice, a focused bench, anvil, tag blanks, and restrained lineage motifs make tag growth feel materially distinct without replacing the odds, cost, or native selection controls.
visual_requirements.state_family_requirement: One neutral precision-selection state; success/hold/damage remain native dynamic UI and are not baked into the artwork.
composition_constraints: No UI, text, numerals, logos, watermarks, or button-like boxes inside the raster.
Leave the central selection column and lower decision area legible for native Godot controls.
Depict neither a guaranteed success nor forced damage; the image must stay neutral to the actual roll.

visual_requirements.primary_use: A returned workpiece and trace of its journey let the player read customer actual-use consequence as part of the same item story, while native result text distinguishes mission outcome from any conditional damage.
visual_requirements.state_family_requirement: One neutral return/result state; no-damage and damage copy, values, repair eligibility, and next action stay native UI.
composition_constraints: No UI, text, numerical durability display, logo, watermark, customer portrait, combat scene, or forced damage depiction inside the raster.
Keep an uncluttered center/lower area for native causal result and next-action controls.
Show an actual-use return trace without implying that handoff itself caused damage.
